rationale: The run landed on the Moncler homepage (/en-gb/) with no product tiles. Moncler commonly displays cookie and country modals and requires navigating to a category PLP. We add a reliable seeded PLP URL, robust PLP/PDP selectors, and pre-click handlers for cookie/region popups via overrides (no code changes). URL normalization enforces en-gb, strips tracking parameters, and blocks misredirects to monclergroup.com. These minimal patches should allow the scraper to land on a proper PLP, see product cards, and reach PDPs to extract title and price.
code_hints: If the resolved URL is the Moncler homepage or just the locale root, immediately rewrite to the seeded PLP (men/outerwear) before navigation to ensure tiles materialize.
Before waiting for PLP selectors, attempt to click OneTrust cookie consent (#onetrust-accept-btn-handler) and any country/region modal 'Continue' button. Retry clicks if detached once.
Set Accept-Language to en-GB and timezone to Europe/London to reduce geolocation-driven redirects to other locales.
After navigating to the PLP, wait for at least one of the PLP selectors and then scroll to the bottom once to trigger lazy loading before collecting product tiles.
Extract PDP links from product_card > a elements constrained to /en-gb/ and prefer links containing '/p/' when available to avoid non-PDP anchors.
On PDP, wait for the title selector first; if price text node is empty initially, wait for [itemprop='price'] to have non-empty textContent before reading.
